category_title: Students with visual impairments who use physical aggression to regain teacher attention
scenario_title: Reward activity interrupted by conversation with teacher
minimal_context: The student is in the music room selecting between drums and a tambourine for a reward activity while the music teacher sits nearby at his desk.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are in the music room now. Do you want to play on the drums or the tambourine as a reward?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Chooses the tambourine and begins playing with it.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, go ahead. (Turns toward the music teacher sitting at his desk) Do you have a moment for a quick word?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pauses playing the tambourine, realizing that the instructor is no longer providing their full attention.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: (Continues conversation with the music teacher) Yes, we just finished up our last activity.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Moves nearby and strikes the instructor to immediately get the attention she is seeking.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: We are in the music room now. Do you want to play on the drums or the tambourine as a reward?

STUDENT: (Chooses the tambourine and begins playing with it.)

TUTOR: Okay, go ahead. (Turns toward the music teacher sitting at his desk) Do you have a moment for a quick word?

STUDENT: (Pauses playing the tambourine, realizing that the instructor is no longer providing their full attention.)

TUTOR: (Continues conversation with the music teacher) Yes, we just finished up our last activity.

STUDENT: (Moves nearby and strikes the instructor to immediately get the attention she is seeking.)

task.content: Selecting a reward activity and playing with a tambourine

context.social_setting: Music teacher who is sitting at his desk is nearby
context.time_context: Once they are in the music room

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: As she is playing with it, the instructor has a word with the music teacher who is sitting at his desk.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: The student, who is nearby, once again strikes the instructor.
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: The student realizes that the instructor is not providing his or her full attention.

behavior_patterns.condition: When the instructor tells the music teacher that she had better stop talking after being struck
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: The student immediately received the attention that she sought and discovered that violent behavior was an effective way to get the result that she wanted.
